$comment: Structural capabilities the improvement engine checks for, even when every test passes. Each entry is a deterministic PROBE against the repository, not an opinion. A failed probe becomes a finding only with evidence tying it to the North Star, and the remedy it proposes is a HYPOTHESIS with lower confidence than the gap itself. An entry here is not a promise to build anything. L3: adding a capability here changes what the engine looks for.

capabilities.capability: Verification runs on the product line itself
capabilities.north_star: Every claim AWE makes about itself rests on verified engineering state; without CI on pcc-production, that state is a session's report again.

capabilities.capability: The Windows install path (NSSM service, IIS/ARR, scheduled backup task) is exercised by a machine before LIPELE-RDS02
capabilities.north_star: The first installation is the gate to works_in_production; the Windows half of it has no machine evidence at all.

capabilities.capability: A defined, repeatable route for production records to reach the evidence layer (plan, readiness, case study)
capabilities.north_star: measurable_value and the first case study are computed from the production database; if nothing defines how its records leave RDS02, the first measured outcome waits on improvisation.
